members.name: Palm Beach
members.bio: Long beach at the northern tip of the Northern Beaches, with ferries and the walk up to Barrenjoey.

members.name: Barrenjoey Lighthouse
members.bio: 1881 sandstone lighthouse 91 m up Barrenjoey Head, reached by a walk of about 30 minutes from Palm Beach.
members.hours: Walk open daily; interior by Sunday tour 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM

members.name: West Head
members.bio: Clifftop lookout over Broken Bay, Pittwater and Barrenjoey, with Aboriginal engravings on a nearby walk.
members.hours: 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM (until 8:30 PM in daylight saving)

members.name: Whale Beach
members.bio: Peaceful beach with a smaller rose-gold cove between two cliffs, and host of the Big Swim each January.

members.name: Windsor
members.bio: Hawkesbury River town settled around 1791, with some of Australia's oldest buildings and Thompson Square.
members.photo_file: St Matthews Anglican Church, Windsor, New South Wales 03.jpg

members.name: Cattai National Park
members.bio: Hawkesbury River park with a c.1820 homestead, a c.1806 windmill, camping and canoeing.
members.hours: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Sep–Apr); 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM (May–Aug). Closed weekdays 12–23 Oct 2026
members.photo_file: Cattai national park view from cattai wharf.jpg

members.name: Scheyville National Park
members.bio: Park around a post-WWII migrant camp, with a heritage walk and a Longneck Lagoon bird walk.
members.hours: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Sep–Apr); 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM (May–Aug). Longneck boardwalk closed
members.photo_file: Scheyville national park longneck lagoon north swamp.jpg

members.name: Penrith Whitewater Stadium
members.bio: Sydney 2000 Olympic course, a 320 m man-made river with Grade 3 rapids, for booked rafting and kayaking.
members.hours: Booked sessions only (no fixed public hours)

members.name: Sydney Zoo
members.bio: Western Sydney Parklands zoo at Bungarribee with African, Asian and Australian animals and an aquarium.

members.name: Camden
members.bio: Historic country town on Sydney's edge, grown from John Macarthur's Camden Park estate, with a free museum.

members.name: Campbelltown
members.bio: Macarthur district hub with the free Campbelltown Arts Centre, a Japanese garden and two heritage walks.
members.photo_file: Mawson Park, Campbelltown, New South Wales 01.jpg

members.name: Picton
members.bio: Town at the Southern Highlands' northern edge, with Victoria Bridge, the Mushroom Tunnel and the George IV Inn.

members.name: Thirlmere Lakes National Park
members.bio: World Heritage park of five freshwater lakes, with a 6 km walking track and picnic areas near Picton.
members.hours: 5:30 AM – 8:00 PM (daylight saving); 5:30 AM – 6:00 PM otherwise. Lake Couridjah picnic area closed to 30 Nov 2026
members.photo_file: Thirlmere Lake, Thirlmere National Park - panoramio.jpg

members.name: Audley
members.bio: Royal National Park hub on the Hacking River, with an 1893 boatshed hiring canoes, kayaks and rowboats.
members.hours: 7:00 AM – 8:30 PM; Visitor Centre 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM; boatshed 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM Tue–Sun

members.name: Wattamolla Beach
members.bio: Calm lagoon, beach and waterfall in Royal National Park, with picnic areas under cabbage tree palms.

members.name: Bundeena to Otford Coast Track
members.bio: A 27 km walk from Bundeena to Otford along Royal National Park's coast, usually done over two days.
members.photo_file: Royal National Park Coast Track - panoramio.jpg

members.name: Garie Beach
members.bio: Road-access surf beach and picnic area on the Coast Track, with whale watching and a campground nearby.

members.name: Wedding Cake Rock
members.bio: White sandstone block on a clifftop an hour's walk from Bundeena, viewed from behind a safety fence.
members.hours: Daytime viewing (park open 7:00 AM – 8:30 PM); closed in total fire bans
members.photo_file: Wedding Cake Rock in Royal National Park.jpg

members.name: Bundeena
members.bio: Village on Port Hacking reached by Cronulla ferry, with a bay beach, cafes and the Coast Track's northern end.
members.photo_file: Hordern Beach, Bundeena, New South Wales.jpg

members.name: Burning Palms Beach
members.bio: Remote Coast Track beach south of Garie, with Figure Eight Pools a short walk away, safe only at low tide.
members.photo_file: Royal National Park - Burning Palms Beach.jpg

members.name: Mount Panorama Circuit
members.bio: Public road around Wahluu, drivable outside race periods, with views and a boardwalk at the top.
members.hours: Open to public traffic outside race periods
members.photo_file: Mount Panorama Pit Straight and Pit Lane 2015.JPG

members.name: National Motor Racing Museum
members.bio: Motor racing museum beside the Mount Panorama track on Panorama Avenue, with an Immersive Room.

members.name: Australian Fossil and Mineral Museum
members.bio: Council-run museum of fossils and minerals on Howick Street in Bathurst.

members.name: Mount Canobolas
members.bio: Dormant volcano near Orange, last erupted 11 million years ago, with walking tracks and picnic places.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (may close for poor weather or fire danger)

members.name: Orange Wine Region
members.bio: Wine region above 600 m around Orange, planted from 1980, with cellar doors open for tasting.

members.name: Carcoar
members.bio: Small heritage village of about 270 people, the third oldest settlement west of the Great Dividing Range.
members.photo_file: Over looking the village of Carcoar 01.jpg

members.name: Taronga Western Plains Zoo
members.bio: Zoo on Obley Road in Dubbo, open every day of the year, with bike, cart and pedal-boat hire.
members.photo_file: 2020-10-08 Giraffe (Giraffa camelopardalis) in Taronga Western Plains Zoo 1.jpg

members.name: Old Dubbo Gaol
members.bio: Former gaol on Macquarie Street in Dubbo, open seven days, with immersive theatrical displays.

members.name: Royal Flying Doctor Service Visitor Experience
members.bio: The Royal Flying Doctor Service's Dubbo base, with a hands-on visitor experience at the airport.
members.hours: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Sat 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM; Sun 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM
members.photo_file: Royal Flying Doctor Service Visitor Experience at Dubbo Airport.jpg

members.name: Wellington Caves
members.bio: Guided-only tours of Cathedral Cave and Gaden Cave, with a Discovery Lab, near Wellington.

members.name: Zig Zag Railway
members.bio: Steam railway running four daily rides from Clarence, lasting 45 minutes to 1 hour 45 minutes.
members.photo_file: The old Lithgow zigzag, now part of the Zig Zag Railway.jpg

members.name: Glow Worm Tunnel
members.bio: Walk to a 387 m former Wolgan Valley railway tunnel in Wollemi National Park, home to glow-worms.
members.hours: Open 24 hours; 4WD recommended; park fire ban until 31 Mar 2027

members.name: Gardens of Stone National Park
members.bio: Rock pagodas, sandstone cliffs and canyons in a World Heritage park, with the Pantoneys Crown mesa.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (may close for poor weather or fire danger)
members.photo_file: Lost City at Gardens of Stone Conservation Area.jpg

members.name: Capertee Valley
members.bio: Described as one of the widest enclosed canyons, seen from Pearsons Lookout near Glen Davis.
